name: What types of materials are used for walk-in shower walls and floors?

mainEntity.name: What types of materials are used for walk-in shower walls and floors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common materials for walk-in shower walls and floors include ceramic, porcelain, and natural stone tiles (such as marble or granite). Porcelain tiles are popular for their durability and low maintenance, while natural stone offers a luxurious appearance but may require more sealing. Other options include solid surface panels, which provide a seamless, grout-free finish, or acrylic/fiberglass panels for a more cost-effective solution. Material choice often depends on budget, desired aesthetic, and maintenance preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common materials include ceramic, porcelain, and natural stone tiles, along with solid surface or acrylic/fiberglass panels.
